what: The proposed SKILL.md changes add exact Step 3.6 skip breadcrumbs for tally-error, degraded-empty-collector, panel-failed, cap-reached, plan-size-trigger, and plan-validator-defects, but the approval-gates.md section of the plan only updates bypass prose and does not require the same breadcrumb strings there.
scenario_or_breakage: After implementation, SKILL.md and approval-gates.md can have aligned routing lists but non-identical breadcrumb coverage, violating the plan-review directive that both files carry strictly identical breadcrumb strings for every Step 3 bypass status.
suggested_fix: Add the same six Step 3.6 skip breadcrumb literals to approval-gates.md, byte-for-byte matching SKILL.md, alongside the Gate-B-bypass status list; keep this as a compact list/table to avoid broader prose churn.
